text.tspan: In Kahoots with the Undead — System Architecture
Lab 5 · Docker Compose project pad-team1 · one public entry (API Gateway), one internal bus (Message Broker), 8 domain services, each with its own database
TypeScript/Fastify · the only public entry point
verifies the JWT · route table · internal routes answer 404
session cache + logout · GET-answer cache (X-Cache: HIT/MISS)
consistent-hash ring (160 vnodes per node) over cache-1..3
TypeScript · registry of every running instance
url · grpc_url · topics each instance listens to
health sweep every 10 s, evicts dead instances
TypeScript · one thread per delivery · broker-data volume (SQLite): topic queues, dead letters, saga log
every call between services goes through the broker too (REST, gRPC, topic events)
WebSocket · 30 s ticket from the Gateway, then straight to Player / Game (not through the broker)
DATA · one PostgreSQL 16 database per service, no service reads another's
etcd ×3 · leader election for the 4 Patroni clusters (quorum 2 of 3)
exam-db · world-db · base-db · crafting-db stay single-node
TypeScript · every 60 s and on POST /v1/runs
read-only sources · one run at a time
Shared logs volume /var/log/pad/<service>/<instance>.log — written by every component; the Gateway merges it into one download: GET /api/logs (admin key)
